qs.stem: The distance of the point (-4, 3) from the line 6x + 8y + 40 = 0 is
qs.trap: Forgetting to divide by √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).

qs.stem: The maximum value of f(x) = −2x<sup>2</sup> + 12x + 1 is
steps: The maximum occurs at x = 3 and equals 19.
qs.trap: Reading the constant term 1 as the maximum.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (0, -2, 3) from the plane 2x + 6y + 9z + 29 = 0 is
steps: Distance = |ax<sub>1</sub> + by<sub>1</sub> + cz<sub>1</sub> + d|/√(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>).
qs.trap: Forgetting the square-root denominator.

qs.stem: If P(A) = 1/6, P(B) = 1/8 and P(A ∩ B) = 1/12, then P(A ∪ B) is
steps: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B).
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the overlap.

qs.stem: If tan A = 1/3 and tan B = 1/4, then tan(A + B) is
steps: tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B).
qs.trap: Using + in the denominator.

qs.stem: The value of i + i<sup>2</sup> + i<sup>3</sup> + … + i<sup>60</sup> is
steps: Every block of four consecutive powers of i adds up to 0.
60 = 4 × 15 + 0, so only the last 0 term(s) remain.
qs.trap: Forgetting that i + i<sup>2</sup> + i<sup>3</sup> + i<sup>4</sup> = 0.

qs.stem: If A is a 3 × 3 matrix with det A = 4, then det(2A) equals
steps: det(kA) = k<sup>n</sup> det A for an n × n matrix.
qs.trap: Multiplying det A by k only once.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 6 terms of the geometric progression 1, 3, 9, … is
qs.trap: Using r<sup>n+1</sup> instead of r<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: If dy/dx = 2y with y(0) = 5, then y(ln 3 / 2) equals
steps: At x = ln 3/2: e<sup>ln 3</sup> = 3, so y = 5 × 3 = 15.
qs.trap: Evaluating e<sup>kx</sup> as x instead of e<sup>ln m</sup> = m.

qs.stem: The number of distinct arrangements of all the letters of the word BALLOON is
steps: The word has 7 letters. Repeated letters: L×2 O×2.
qs.trap: Not dividing by the factorial of each repeated letter.

qs.stem: The area (in square units) of the region bounded by y = x<sup>2</sup> and y = 6x is
steps: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 6.
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the area under the parabola.

qs.stem: The number of symmetric relations on a set with 4 elements is
steps: A symmetric relation is fixed by choosing among the 4 diagonal pairs and the 6 unordered off-diagonal pairs.
qs.trap: Ignoring the diagonal pairs.

qs.stem: A committee of 4 is chosen from 7 men and 6 women. The number of committees containing at least one woman is
qs.trap: Counting a committee with two women twice (choose one woman, then anyone).

qs.stem: For the vectors a = 0i +0j −1k and b = 4i +2j +1k, |a × b|<sup>2</sup> equals
qs.trap: Using + (a·b)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→2</sub> (x<sup>2</sup> − 4)/(x − 2) equals
steps: The limit is the derivative of x<sup>2</sup> at x = 2.
qs.trap: Writing a<sup>m</sup> instead of a<sup>m−1</sup>.

qs.stem: The value of the integral ∫<sub>0</sub><sup>5</sup> (6x<sup>2</sup> + 2x) dx is
qs.trap: Dropping the 1/3 or 1/2 factor.

qs.stem: If α and β are the roots of x<sup>2</sup> − 5x + 4 = 0, then α<sup>2</sup> + β<sup>2</sup> is equal to
qs.trap: Using +2αβ instead of −2αβ.

qs.stem: Two fair dice are thrown. The probability that the sum is 7 given that at least one die shows 3 is
steps: Outcomes with at least one 3: 11 (out of 36).
Of these, the sum is 7 in 2 cases.
qs.trap: Dividing by 36 instead of by the reduced sample space.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 12 terms of the arithmetic progression 9, 12, 15, … is
qs.trap: Using nd instead of (n − 1)d.

qs.stem: The determinant of the matrix with rows [−1 2 3]   [−1 −1 3]   [1 −3 2] is
steps: Expand along the first row: a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg).
qs.trap: Sign slip on the middle term of the expansion.

qs.stem: The radius of the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> − 2x − 8y + 13 = 0 is
steps: Compare with x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0: g = −1, f = −4, c = 13.
qs.trap: Reporting r<sup>2</sup> instead of r.

qs.stem: For a binomial distribution the mean is 10 and the variance is 5. The number of trials n is
steps: Mean = np and variance = npq, so q = variance/mean = 1/2 and p = 1/2.
qs.trap: Taking n = mean or n = mean + variance.

qs.stem: The number of solutions of cos 2x = 0 in the interval [0, 2π] is
steps: Write the general solution and count the values of x that fall in [0, 2π], including both end points.
qs.trap: Missing an end point of the closed interval.

qs.stem: If A = [[1, 1], [0, 1]], the sum of all the entries of A<sup>6</sup> is
steps: A<sup>6</sup> = [[1, 6], [0, 1]], whose entries add up to 2 + 6 = 8.
qs.trap: Computing A<sup>p</sup> as entrywise powers.

qs.stem: If f(x) = x<sup>3</sup> − 1x<sup>2</sup> − 3x, then f′(3) equals
qs.trap: Evaluating f instead of f′.

qs.stem: A block slides down a rough incline of angle 37° (sin 37° = 0.6, cos 37° = 0.8) with coefficient of friction 0.25. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, its acceleration is (in m/s<sup>2</sup>)
qs.trap: Swapping sinθ and cosθ.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 1% error and the speed a 3% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: Two trains of lengths 300 m and 100 m move towards each other on parallel tracks at 30 m/s and 50 m/s. They take how many seconds to cross each other completely?
qs.trap: Using the difference of speeds (that is for the same direction).

qs.stem: The energy of the electron in the n = 3 orbit of a He<sup>+</sup> ion is (in eV)
qs.trap: Using Z instead of Z<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: Two point charges of 6 μC and 4 μC are placed 3 cm apart in air (1/4πε<sub>0</sub> = 9 × 10<sup>9</sup> N m<sup>2</sup>/C<sup>2</sup>). The force between them is (in N)
qs.trap: Converting cm to m incorrectly.

qs.stem: A system absorbs 600 J of heat and does 190 J of work on its surroundings. The change in its internal energy is (in J)
qs.trap: Adding work done by the system to the heat absorbed.

qs.stem: Resistors of 10 Ω and 15 Ω in parallel are connected in series with a 4 Ω resistor across a 20 V battery of negligible resistance. The current drawn from the battery is (in A)
qs.trap: Adding all three resistances in series.

qs.stem: The absolute pressure at a depth of 4 m in a liquid of density 800 kg/m<sup>3</sup>, with atmospheric pressure 1.0 × 10<sup>5</sup> Pa and g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, is (in kPa)
qs.trap: Leaving out atmospheric pressure.

qs.stem: An ideal transformer has 50 turns in the primary and 150 in the secondary. The primary current is 6 A. The secondary current is (in A)
steps: Ideal transformer: V<sub>p</sub>I<sub>p</sub> = V<sub>s</sub>I<sub>s</sub>, so I<sub>s</sub>/I<sub>p</sub> = N<sub>p</sub>/N<sub>s</sub>.
qs.trap: Using the voltage ratio for currents.

qs.stem: A 1 kg mass attached to a spring of constant 36 N/m oscillates with amplitude 5 cm. Its maximum speed is (in cm/s)
qs.trap: Using ω<sup>2</sup> instead of ω.

qs.stem: In Young's double-slit experiment the slit separation is 0.24 mm, the screen is 1.5 m away and the wavelength is 480 nm. The fringe width is (in mm)
qs.trap: Unit slip between nm, mm and m.

qs.stem: The moment of inertia of a thin ring of mass 12 kg and radius 0.5 m about an axis through its centre (perpendicular to the plane for the disc and ring) is (in kg m<sup>2</sup>)
steps: I = 1 MR<sup>2</sup> for a thin ring.
qs.trap: Using the wrong numerical factor for the shape.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 800 N/m is compressed by 0.05 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: A body weighs 90 N on the surface of the earth (radius R). Its weight at a height of 2R above the surface is (in N)
steps: g′ = g R<sup>2</sup>/(R + h)<sup>2</sup> = g/(1 + h/R)<sup>2</sup> = g/9.
qs.trap: Dividing by (R + h) instead of (R + h)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: Light of wavelength 124 nm falls on a metal of work function 6 eV (hc = 1240 eV nm). The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is (in eV)
qs.trap: Giving the photon energy instead of the kinetic energy.

qs.stem: A straight wire of length 1 m carrying 20 A is placed in a uniform magnetic field of 0.1 T at 30° to the field. The force on the wire is (in N)
qs.trap: Leaving out sinθ (or using cosθ).

qs.stem: The dimensional formula of (momentum ÷ frequency) is
qs.trap: Adding exponents when dividing.

qs.stem: Two masses 6 kg and 2 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 3 μF and 6 μF are connected in parallel. The equivalent capacitance is (in μF)
qs.trap: Mixing up the series and parallel formulas.

qs.stem: A 2 kg block is pulled on a rough horizontal floor (μ = 0.5) by a horizontal force of 30 N through 10 m. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the gain in kinetic energy is (in J)
steps: Net work = (F − f)d = (30 − 10) × 10 = 200 J = gain in K.E.
qs.trap: Ignoring the work done against friction.

qs.stem: A rotating platform has moment of inertia 4 kg m<sup>2</sup> and angular speed 12 rad/s. A person on it changes the moment of inertia to 6 kg m<sup>2</sup> without any external torque. The new angular speed is (in rad/s)
steps: Angular momentum is conserved: I<sub>1</sub>ω<sub>1</sub> = I<sub>2</sub>ω<sub>2</sub>.
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio of the moments of inertia.

qs.stem: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: A Carnot engine works between a source at 400 K and a sink at 300 K. Its efficiency (in %) is
qs.trap: Using T<sub>2</sub>/T<sub>1</sub> as the efficiency.

qs.stem: A body is projected with speed 100 m/s at an angle whose sine is 0.6. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the maximum height reached is (in m)
qs.trap: Using the full speed instead of the vertical component.

qs.stem: A radioactive sample has half-life 3 days and initially 640 nuclei (in thousands). The number remaining after 15 days is (in thousands)
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives rather than by 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: The number of peptide bonds in a linear polypeptide made from 6 amino acid residues is
steps: n residues joined in a chain have n − 1 peptide bonds.
qs.trap: Counting one bond per residue.

qs.stem: The depression in freezing point of a 0.5 m aqueous solution of NaCl (assume complete dissociation) is (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K kg/mol; in K)
steps: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = i K<sub>f</sub> m with van't Hoff factor i = 2.
qs.trap: Using i = 1 for an electrolyte.

qs.stem: The number of unpaired electrons in the complex [Ti(H<sub>2</sub>O)<sub>6</sub>]<sup>3+</sup> is
steps: The metal ion is Ti<sup>3+</sup>; use the ligand field strength to decide high-spin or low-spin filling.
qs.trap: Assuming high-spin for every complex.

qs.stem: The number of sigma (σ) bonds in ethanal (CH<sub>3</sub>CHO) is
steps: Every bond has one σ bond; each double bond adds one π bond and each triple bond adds two.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as one π bond.

qs.stem: Among S, Na, Cl, F, the element with the lowest electronegativity (Pauling scale) is
steps: Pauling values: S 2.5, Na 0.9, Cl 3.0, F 4.0.
qs.trap: Reading the trend down a group the wrong way.

qs.stem: For a reaction ΔH = -60 kJ and ΔS = -150 J/K. The value of ΔG at 300 K is (in kJ)
qs.trap: Not converting J to kJ.

qs.stem: The degree of unsaturation (double-bond equivalents) of C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>5</sub>Cl is
steps: DBE = (2C + 2 + N − H − X)/2 (oxygen does not count).
qs.trap: Counting oxygen or forgetting that N adds 1.

qs.stem: The number of moles of H<sub>2</sub> needed to hydrogenate 1 mole of hex-1-en-5-yne completely is
steps: Add 1 mol H<sub>2</sub> per C=C (or per ring in a saturated ring), 2 mol per C≡C, and 3 mol per benzene ring.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as taking one mole.

qs.stem: The mass of glucose (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>) required to prepare 500 mL of a 1 M solution is (in g)
qs.trap: Using the volume in mL without converting to litres.

qs.stem: The rate law of a substitution reaction is rate = k[RX]. If the concentrations of both RX and Nu<sup>−</sup> are multiplied by 2, the rate changes by a factor of
steps: The rate depends only on the species present in the rate law, each to its own power.
qs.trap: Counting a species that is not in the rate law.

qs.stem: A first-order reaction has 96 g of reactant initially. After 3 half-lives the amount left is (in g)
steps: After each half-life the amount halves.
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives instead of 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: The maximum number of electrons that the shell with n = 3 can hold is
steps: Number of orbitals = n<sup>2</sup> = 9, each holding 2 electrons.
qs.trap: Giving n<sup>2</sup>, the number of orbitals.

qs.stem: A buffer contains an acid HA (pK<sub>a</sub> = 6) and its salt with [A<sup>−</sup>]/[HA] = 10. Its pH is
qs.trap: Inverting the salt/acid ratio.

qs.stem: The oxidation number of S in S<sub>2</sub>O<sub>8</sub><sup>2−</sup> (peroxodisulphate, including the peroxide bond) is
steps: Assign O = −2 (or the usual values) and balance the total charge.
qs.trap: Forgetting the overall charge on the ion.

qs.stem: For a reaction A + B → products, doubling [A] alone raises the rate 4 times, and doubling [B] alone raises it 1 times. The overall order of the reaction is
steps: Rate ∝ [A]<sup>x</sup>[B]<sup>y</sup>: 2<sup>x</sup> = 4 gives x = 2 and 2<sup>y</sup> = 1 gives y = 0.
qs.trap: Adding the rate factors instead of the exponents.

qs.stem: The number of different monochloro structural isomers obtainable from neopentane (2,2-dimethylpropane) by free-radical chlorination (ignore stereoisomers) is
steps: Count the sets of equivalent hydrogens: each set gives one monochloro product.
qs.trap: Counting every hydrogen as different.

qs.stem: 25 mL of a 6 M solution is diluted until its molarity is 1 M. The final volume of the solution is (in mL)
qs.trap: Giving the volume of water added instead of the final volume.

qs.stem: Liquids A and B form an ideal solution of 1 mol A and 4 mol B. Their vapour pressures when pure are 500 mm Hg and 100 mm Hg. The total vapour pressure of the solution is (in mm Hg)
qs.trap: Averaging the two pure vapour pressures without weighting by mole fraction.

qs.stem: The mass of copper (molar mass 64 g/mol, ion charge 2+) deposited by passing 579000 C of charge is (in g; F = 96500 C/mol)
qs.trap: Ignoring the charge on the ion.

qs.stem: For hydrogen-like species, the ratio of the radius of the n = 4 orbit to that of the n = 1 orbit (same species) is
qs.trap: Using r ∝ n instead of n<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the compound C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>6</sub>O (alcohols and ethers) is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: For N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> ⇌ 2NH<sub>3</sub> the equilibrium concentrations are [N<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M, [H<sub>2</sub>] = 2 M and [NH<sub>3</sub>] = 12 M. The value of K<sub>c</sub> is
qs.trap: Writing the ratio upside-down or ignoring the stoichiometric powers.

qs.stem: From the reaction 2H<sub>2</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → 2H<sub>2</sub>O, the mass of water formed from 4 g of hydrogen (completely reacted) is (in g)
steps: 1 mol of hydrogen gives 1 mol of water, so moles of water = 2.
qs.trap: Ignoring the mole ratio in the balanced equation.

qs.stem: The number of moles of O<sub>2</sub> required for complete combustion of 1 mole of the hydrocarbon C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>4</sub> is
qs.trap: Using y/2 instead of y/4.

qs.stem: The steric number (bond pairs + lone pairs) of the central atom in XeF<sub>4</sub>, which has a square planar shape, is
steps: 4 bond pairs and 2 lone pairs on Xe.
qs.trap: Ignoring the lone pairs.
